title: Arie Crown Theater

services.name: Corporate Events
services.desc: Make a memorable corporate event experience at the Arie Crown, Chicago’s premier rentable theater for offsite meetings, product launches, keynote addresses and more. Just minutes from downtown Chicago with spectacular views of both Lake Michigan and the city’s iconic skyline, the Arie Crown Theater is a convenient offsite venue for anyone. Situated within McCormick Place, the nation’s largest convention center, the Arie Crown Theater offers plenty of parking and prime regional access supported by a hub of transportation networks including two international airports and regional trains. View a Drone’s Eye View of the Arie Crown Theater. The Arie Crown Theater is a full-production proscenium
